Opal once stayed late to troubleshoot a billing anomaly that was inflating our cloud costs by 30%. She cross-referenced usage logs with team workflows, identified redundant microservices, and rearchitected resource allocation. The fix saved $12k monthly without compromising SLAs. Her curiosity about systemic inefficiencies often led her to volunteer for cost audits, turning them into opportunities to rethink scalability.  

Opal is NexaCorp’s go-to for balancing technical rigor with business priorities. She thrives in ambiguity, translating vague client needs into concrete AI solutions. Last quarter, she led a team to deploy a chatbot that reduced customer support tickets by 40% while maintaining 95% user satisfaction. Her ability to distill complex problems into actionable steps is unmatched.  

What sets her apart is her relentless attention to detail and ethical lens. When our team debated deploying a risky LLM variant, she pushed for rigorous testing, ultimately avoiding a potential $500k liability. She’s equally comfortable debating model architecture with engineers as she is crafting stakeholder presentations.  

Opal’s blend of technical depth and business acumen makes her a rare asset. She’ll elevate any team she joins.
